title: Emphasis: 是…的, 不是…吗, 连…都
description: Highlighting when / where / how something happened (是…的), rhetorical 'isn't it?', and 'even …' with 连…都.

points.title: 是 … 的: focus on the details of a past event
points.summary: When everyone knows it happened, 是…的 asks or tells **when, where, how, with whom**. 是 can be dropped; 的 can't.
points.body:
- 你是什么时候来**的**? — 我是去年来**的**.
- 我是坐飞机来**的**.
- ~~我是坐飞机来了~~ ✗

points.title: 不是 … 吗?: isn't it …?
points.summary: A rhetorical question: the speaker is sure (and often surprised or annoyed).
points.body:
- 你**不是**说今天不来**吗**? 怎么来了?
- 这**不是**你的书**吗**? (This is your book, isn't it?)
examples: Didn't you say you weren't coming today?

points.title: 连 … 都 / 也: even
points.summary: 连 + X + 都 / 也 + verb = even X ….
points.body:
- **连**小孩子**都**知道.
- 他忙得**连**饭**都**没吃.
examples: {这个|zhège}{问题|wèntí}{连|lián}{小孩子|xiǎo háizi}{都|dōu}{知道|zhīdào}。

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{是|shì}{什么|shénme}{时候|shíhou}{来|lái}{中国|Zhōngguó}{的|de}？
B：{我|wǒ}{是|shì}{去年|qùnián}（　）。
notes: 来着 isn't the pattern.
是…来了 doesn't go together.
来过 = 'have been (before)'.
questions.translation: A: When did you come to China? B: Last year.

notes: 是 pairs with 的, not 了.
的 goes at the end.
是 goes before the detail you emphasise.

questions.prompt: Which sentence focuses on **when** he came (we already know he came)?
notes: The detail goes between 是 and the verb.
This just reports that he came.
Time words go before the verb.
questions.translation: It was yesterday that he came.

notes: 不有 doesn't exist.
没是 doesn't exist.
The order is 不是.
questions.translation: Didn't you say you weren't coming today? How come you're here?

questions.prompt: What does 「{这|zhè}{不是|búshì}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{书|shū}{吗|ma}？」 mean?
notes: It's a question that expects 'yes'.
That's 这是谁的书?
That would be 是不是你的书?

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{问题|wèntí}{太|tài}{简单|jiǎndān}{了|le}，{连|lián}{小孩子|xiǎo háizi}（　）{知道|zhīdào}。
notes: The pair is 连…都 / 也.
The pair is 连…都 / 也.
The pair is 连…都 / 也.
questions.translation: This question is so easy that even a child knows the answer.

notes: 又没吃 = 'didn't eat again'.
连…才 isn't the pattern.
连…就 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: He was so busy today he didn't even eat.

notes: 连 goes before 一个字.
都 comes before the verb phrase.
连 comes first, 都 second.
questions.translation: He doesn't even know a single character.
